description: This file defines a PHP class `ValidationLeaveEntitlementValueAPI` that acts as an API endpoint for validating leave entitlement values within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It includes methods to handle HTTP GET requests for validating if a leave entitlement is valid based on the provided entitlement parameter, leveraging various imported modules and traits related to leave entitlement services and permissions.
